name: Duanmu Fei Yiwen Lu
source:
This visual novel comprises of several stories about the adventures of DUANMU Fei, the protagonist,
While solving these weird supernatural cases, DUANMU learns more about the wordly life instead.
Please enjoy the stories with a cup of coffee!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/593200/]Steam[/url]]
